notes: Large-unit check retained: מִלְּבַד → 'besides' is one rendering of three function morphemes, headed on בַד as the morpheme carrying the content (rules 30 and 23).

חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ writes two 'us' phrases and the ASV renders one; the formula's dative is taken as the rendered occurrence and the ablative as the unrendered one under rule 22. The competing reading gives 'from us' to מִמֶּנּוּ, whose own sense 'from' carries, and marks the dative pair unrepresented.

חָלִילָ + directive he is kept as one indivisible 'Far be it'; the alternative treats it as an ordinary rule 30/32 fusion with the copula joining under rule 20, which yields the same arrays and heads and differs only in status.
